components.name: Forward coordinate reconstruction
components.operation: Use one shared base value and d forward displacements with h as specified.
components.requires: Inner-ball base, exact scalar values, global gradient Lipschitzness and outer-ball query permission.

limitations.statement: Fixed forward coordinates, exact arithmetic and exact values; noisy values can be amplified by division by h.
The component alone has no function-gap or minimax guarantee. The source accelerated optimizer is a separate construction.

performance_links.scope_note: Only gradient-estimation error and feasible query accounting under the linked smooth-only statement; no end-to-end optimization complexity.

variants.cost: At most d+1 new exact-value calls without cached data, at most d when the exact base is cached; other exact-point cache hits reduce calls further. There are d differences/divisions and vector assembly, with exact-real computation uncharged in this paper's query model. Re-querying a stored point still costs a call unless the stored value is actually reused.
variants.implementation_details_ref: Original PDF p.8, equations (4.1)–(4.2); cache convention p.7.
variants.name: Single inner-ball gradient estimate
variants.output: g in R^d with ||g-grad f(y)||_2<=delta; optionally the already obtained scalar f(y). No feasible optimizer or objective-gap certificate is returned.
public_inputs: d>=1, beta,R>0, base point y in B_2^d(R/2), target norm error delta>0; exact-value oracle for fixed f.
Optional exact-point cache with known exact values.
variants.query_and_update: Read exact cached f(y) if available, otherwise query it once. For i=1,...,d query (or reuse an exact-point cached value of) f(y+h e_i); set g_i=[f(y+h e_i)-f(y)]/h. Return the assembled vector g.
variants.requirements: f is C^1 with globally beta-Lipschitz gradient; oracle permits every point in B_2^d(R) and returns exact values of the same fixed f. Convexity or a minimizer promise is not required by this local component.
variants.state_and_initialization: Stateless component; fix y,d,beta,R,delta and h=min{R/2,2delta/(beta sqrt(d))}. Allocate d coordinate entries; no optimizer state is initialized.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use the stated h for target delta; stop after all d coordinates are formed. No line search, iteration horizon or optimizer stopping rule belongs to this component.
